items.headline: Global Leaders Gather in Manila for 49th ASEAN Summit
items.summary: Southeast Asian leaders and international partners gathered in Manila for the 49th ASEAN Summit to address regional security and economic cooperation. High-level discussions focused on maritime disputes in the South China Sea, regional trade resilience, and diplomatic responses to the crisis in Myanmar.

items.headline: Tesla Opens Orders for Steering-Wheel-Free Cybercab to Private Buyers
items.summary: Tesla has started inviting select U.S. customers to order its two-seater Cybercab for personal use at a base price of $29,990, with initial deliveries estimated to begin in December. This development is making major news as it marks the first time an automaker is selling a pedal-free, steering-wheel-free autonomous vehicle directly to individual consumers.

items.headline: Alexander Zverev Presented With ATP Year-End No. 1 Trophy
items.summary: German tennis star Alexander Zverev was officially presented with the ATP Year-End No. 1 trophy in Turin on Monday after winning his first two Grand Slam titles at Roland Garros and the US Open this season. The award makes him the first German player in ATP history to finish a season as world number one.

items.headline: Robert Pattinson Officially Cast as the Next James Bond in Upcoming Denis Villeneuve Film
items.summary: Amazon MGM Studios announced that actor Robert Pattinson will star as the seventh official James Bond in a new film directed by Denis Villeneuve. The casting decision marks a major milestone for the six-decade-old franchise as it officially enters its next era following Daniel Craig's final 007 film in 2021.
